## Example files

Build your own file and use examples to check individual operations. Project 4 field and contouring groups may be reused with credit; students still build their own matrix and develop their own envelope. The point-cloud file is a supplementary example, not a required assignment. Select the lesson object and press Home over the node editor to see the whole graph. Read the Frames in order. Change the inputs on the nodes or, where there are controls, in the GeometryNodes modifier.

Prepared in **Blender 5.2.1 LTS**. Older Blender versions may not have the volume nodes used in later classes.

**[Volumetric Data and Fields — point clouds]({{ site.baseurl }}/files/blender/06-point-clouds-volumes/Point-Clouds-and-Volumes.blend)** — download .blend

1. Import points
2. Analyze points
3. Points to volume

Keep the data folder together: the file reads teaching-courtyard.ply from the same folder. It is a made-up point cloud for teaching, not a site survey.

Supporting files: [Teaching point cloud]({{ site.baseurl }}/files/blender/06-point-clouds-volumes/teaching-courtyard.ply), [Dataset source and units]({{ site.baseurl }}/files/blender/06-point-clouds-volumes/teaching-courtyard.json).

**[Volumetric Data and Fields — signed distance and Booleans]({{ site.baseurl }}/files/blender/07-advanced-volumes/Advanced-Volumes-Session-1.blend)** — download .blend

1. Mesh to SDF
2. Signed distance
3. SDF Boolean

**[Volumetric Data and Fields — noise and surface extraction]({{ site.baseurl }}/files/blender/07-advanced-volumes/Advanced-Volumes-Session-2.blend)** — download .blend

1. Noise field
